Why Choose Data Analytics as Your Career? India leads analytics hiring 17.4% of all job postings now require data analytics skills. Rising salaries Entry-level Data Analysts in India earn an average of ₹7.3 LPA (2025). Global demand surging U.S. entry-level Data Analyst salaries have risen from $90K to $111K in 2025. Explosive market growth India’s data analytics industry ($3.55B in 2024) is growing at a 35.8% CAGR through 2030. Frequently Asked Questions About the Course Eligibility and Prerequisites Placement Support Certification and Outcomes Course Structure Fees and Payment Options Is the course available in both classroom and live online modes? Yes, you can choose a classroom or online mode, based on your convenience. Both formats offer lives instructor-led sessions. The content and learning outcomes remain the same. What happens if i miss a live class? Will recordings or backup sessions be available? Recordings are available for every session you miss. You can also attend backup classes with another batch of our data analytics course. Can i switch from classroom to online mode once the course starts? Yes, switching modes is allowed. You can move from classroom to online or vice versa. It's flexible and designed to suit your routine. Who is this data analyst course ideal for - students, professionals, or career changes? The data analyst course is perfect for students, working professionals, fresh graduates, and anyone looking to switch careers. You don't need any prior experience to join. Do i need any coding or mathematics background to join this course? Not at all. Basic logic and simple math are enough to get started. Everything else is taught from scratch. What kind of placement assistance will i get after the cours? You receive job alerts, interview shorlisting support, profile building, and mock interviews. There's a dedicated placement team guiding you until you get placed in our data analytics course. Does ExcelR provide interview preparation and resume/LinkedIn review support? Yes, ExcelR helps with resume building, LinkedIn optimisation, and mock interviews. These services boost your confidence. What kind of companies hire data analysts in india? Data analysts are hired across IT, banking, fintech, consulting, healthcare, retail, and startups. Almost every industry that works with data needs skilled analysts today. Will i get a certificate after complting the course? Yes, you receive and industry-recognised data analytics certification upon completion. It validates your skills for employers. What topics and tools are covered in the data analytics course syllabus? You'll learn Excel, SQL, Tableau, Power BI, statistics, data cleaning, dashboards, and real-world analysis techniques. Each tool is covered practically with industry examples. Is machine learning included in this course? Yes, you'll learn beginner-friendly ML concepts like regression, clustering, and forecasting. These are taught in a simple, practical way-no heavy math required. How much hands-on practice and project work does the course include? You'll work on multiple assignments, mini-projects, and a capstone. Nearly 60-70% of the course is hands-on. You learn by doing! Are live projects based on domains like finance, e-commerce, and marketing? Yes, the projects cover real domains such as BFSI, retail, HR, supply chain, healthcare, and e-commerce. This helps you build a strong portfolio. How will my learning be evaluated - quizzes, assignments, or projects? Your learning is checked through quizzes, assignments, practical tasks, and project submissions. What is the capstone project, and how is it structured? It's a complete nd-to-end project where you work with real datasets, clean them, analyse them, and present insights. You also create dashboards and rports. How can i enrol, and what are the data analyst course fees and EMI options? You can enrol online, via phone, or by visiting a center. Flexible EMI options are available. A counsellor will guide you based on your goals. Are there scholarships, discounts, or refund policies available? Yes, seasonal discounts, referral offers, and scholarship options are available. Refund policies depend on the batch and mode you select. Counsellors can explain these in detail. Our Ratings Across the Web 4.8 4.4 4.7 We Don’t Just Train, We Build Careers! Course Description What does the course offer? The Data Analyst Course covers technologies like Excel, Advanced Excel, Tableau, SQL, Power BI, Basics of R & Python. Apart from the theory classes, there are hands-on assignments and projects that help you apply the concepts that are learnt by a student. Advanced Certification Program in Data Analytics for Digital Transformation from IIT: ExcelR, in association with IITM, brings to you an add-on certification for your Data Analyst Course. This certification program provides you with: 15+ Hours of Interactive Live-Virtual Sessions by professors of IITM. Optional 2-day Campus Immersion in the beautiful, state-of-the-art IITM. A prestigious IIT Certificate. What is the certification process? During the period of your course, interactive live-virtual sessions will be conducted by professors of IITM. An optional campus immersion will also be planned, whereby a slot will be created, and you will travel to Chennai for a two-day experience at the IITM campus. Post training, you will take a short quiz on the topics discussed in the session, which will unlock your Advanced Certification in Data Analytics for Digital Transformation from IIT . Program Highlights Top-Notch Faculty Trainers at ExcelR are passionate about training, and carry vast industry experience. Industry Aligned Curriculum Our industry-relevant course curriculum is tailored to provide practical exposure with the theory. 20+ Capstone Projects Learners will work on real-life data analytics scenarios from various domains to get application knowledge. Job Readiness Intensive interview preparation from Day 1 to prepare candidates for interviews with our network of 5000+ hiring partners. Skills Covered Advanced Excel & Business Analytics Al-Powered Data Analytics Data Visualization & Storytelling DAX & Advanced Power BI Analytics Python for Data Analytics SQL & Database Analytics Tools and Technologies Microsoft Excel PoweBI Tableau MySQL Python Programming R Programming Fundamentals SAS(Self-paced) Microsoft Copilot Google Gemini Chatgpt Claude VBA Data Analyst Project Life Cycle Phase 1 - Data Collection After carefully evaluating the business case in a particular domain, data will be collected surrounding it. Phase 2 - Data Preparation Using SQL, a database will be created to store the data collected in the previous step. Phase 3 - Insights Generation and Dashboard Building Establish a connection between the database and Tableau/Python/R tools to extract the required data. Generate user-friendly reports according to the business needs and develop the dashboard using Tableau/Power BI. Projects Analysis of Patient Data (Domain: Healthcare) This project requires learners to analyze the patient data of those suffering from different diseases across various summaries. The facility, chain organizations, and dialysis stations analysis is required to be carried out where the patients are undergoing dialysis. The project also focuses on the payment mode aspect wherein if any discounts or reduction in payments have happened then those are analyzed. Loan of Customers (Domain: Banking and Finance) In this project, learners analyze the loan given by a financial institution to different customers of varied grades and sub-grade levels. The analysis needs to consider the loan disbursement reasons, funded amount, and revolving balance values for every customer in different states and geolocations. The project requires analyzing the customers’ payment modes and the last payment values. Employee Retention (Domain: HR Analytics) This HR-related project considers the attrition rate of employees working at an organization at different levels. The attrition rate analysis is done with respect to different factors such as monthly income, last promotion year, job role, and work-life balance of every employee of different departments. Industrial Combustion Energy Use (Domain: Energy) The project requires learners to analyze the usage of different fuels in various facilities and applications by finding the MMBTu and GWHt values. The fuels used for different geolocations and for different primary titles are also taken into consideration while performing the analysis. Flights Delay Analysis (Domain: Aviation) The primary aim of the project is to determine the different reasons behind flight delays across various airlines. The analysis needs to consider the number of flights in operation, the number of flights cancelled, and the statistical summary of week-wise, state-wise, and city-wise flight distributions. Olist Store Analysis (Domain: eCommerce) The market for a certain product is analyzed by considering a particular retail outlet which sells these products. The project involves statistical analysis on the payment distribution from different customers with different modes of transactions across various product categories. The feedback from customers with respect to shipping days and other factors also needs to be considered while carrying out the analysis. And More...
